title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Front door Security Policy module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-cdnfrontdoorsecuritypolicy'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Azure Front door Security Policy module

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cdn_frontdoor_firewall_policy_id.description: (Required) The Resource Id of the Front Door Firewall Policy that should be linked to this Front Door Security Policy. Changing this forces a new Front Door Security Policy to be created.

cdn_frontdoor_profile_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Frontdoor profile

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

domain.description: (Required) map(object({ cdn_frontdoor_domain_id = "(Required) The Resource Id of the Front Door Custom Domain or Front Door Endpoint that should be bound to this Front Door Security Policy. Changing this forces a new Front Door Security Policy to be created." }))

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

patterns_to_match.description: (Required) The list of paths to match for this firewall policy. Possible value includes /*. Changing this forces a new Front Door Security Policy to be created.

id.description: The ID of the created frontdoor Security policy.

name.description: The name of the created frontdoor Security Policy.

resource.description: The Cdn Frontdoor Security Policy resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Cdnfrontdoorsecuritypolicy' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
